prompt_md: Toss three fair coins. What's the chance that all three land the same way up (all heads or all tails)?
prompt_short: Three coins. Chance all three land the same way?
explain_intuition_md: Two of the three coins always match, so it feels like everything rides on the last coin: 50%. But which two match isn't fixed in advance, and that sneaks in a bias. Of the 8 equally likely outcomes, only all heads and all tails work.
